Two paths for your company to make decisions with its own numbers: I do it with you, or I teach you to do it.

::: {.caminho #projects}
## Custom projects

[I do it with you.]{.caminho-lema}

For those who need results fast and don't have the time or the team to do it alone.

### How it works

::: passos
1. **A free 30-minute call.** You tell me about the problem and we see together whether it makes sense to work together.
2. **Diagnosis and proposal.** I look at the data and spreadsheets you already have and send a proposal with a fixed scope, timeline and price.
3. **Kickoff.** We sign a confidentiality agreement and you give me access to the data.
4. **Building with previews.** A short weekly call to show progress and adjust course early.
5. **Delivery and walkthrough.** I deliver the dashboard, report or audit in a meeting where I explain how to read and use it. One round of adjustments is included.
6. **Ongoing support, if you want it.** Monthly support to keep the numbers up to date.
:::

[Book a 30-min call](https://wa.me/5537984129390?text=Hi+Felipe+I+want+to+book+a+30+minute+call){.btn .btn-primary}

### What a project can include

::: servico
### Power BI dashboards {#dashboards}

#### Who it is for

Companies and teams that already have data (ERP, spreadsheets, timekeeping systems, APIs) and want to track what matters without building reports by hand every month.

#### What I deliver

- A clean data model, with documented DAX measures.
- Data preparation and refresh in Power Query.
- A dashboard designed for decisions: a few pages, each answering one question.
- Documentation of the calculation rules, so the numbers do not depend on me.

#### How I work

I start with the questions the dashboard has to answer and the data sources available. I show a first prototype early, adjust it with the people who will use it, and only then polish the design. I have built dashboards for working hours with overtime alerts, legal department KPIs fed by an API, fleet violations and PPE inventory.

{{< ver-projetos paineis >}}
:::

::: servico
### Management KPIs {#kpis}

#### Who it is for

Companies where each department calculates the same KPI its own way, or that track many numbers without knowing which ones actually drive decisions.

#### What I deliver

- KPI definitions: what to measure and why.
- A definition sheet for each KPI, with formula, source, frequency, target and owner.
- Governance rules: who can change a definition and how changes are recorded.

#### How I work

I talk to the people who produce the numbers and the people who use them, review what already exists and propose a lean set. At Prumo Engenharia I curated and governed KPIs across several departments; that is where the method comes from.

{{< ver-projetos indicadores >}}
:::

::: servico
### Data reports and audits {#reports}

#### Who it is for

Companies that need a precise answer about a concrete problem: a cost that went up without explanation, a benefit paid outside the rules, a process that leaks money somewhere. Also for teams that already have a dashboard and want to go beyond it on a specific question.

#### What I deliver

- An analytical report in HTML and PDF, with numbers, charts and conclusions written for decision-makers.
- A list of cases to review, ranked by risk and by amount.
- Practical recommendations and KPIs to keep track of the problem afterward.
- The analysis code, so you can rerun the report whenever you want.

#### How I work

I start by understanding the business rule and where the data come from. I cross-check the sources, test each rule and separate objective errors from what only deserves a second look. Before pointing to any amount, I validate the conclusions with the people who know the process.

{{< ver-projetos relatorios >}}
:::

:::

## Group mentoring

[I teach you to solve it.]{.caminho-lema}

For managers and business owners who want to understand their own numbers, build their KPIs and make decisions with more confidence, without depending on anyone.

::: caminho-formato
**Format:** 6 weekly 90-minute sessions, online and live, in small groups, always with exercises using your own company's data. Pricing on request.
:::

### How it works

::: passos
1. **Waitlist.** You join through WhatsApp and get notified about the next cohort.
2. **Free open class.** Before each cohort, an open class so you can get to know the method.
3. **Founding cohort.** 5 to 10 people, with a special founder rate.
4. **The 6 sessions.**
    1. What to measure in your business.
    2. Organize the data in a reliable spreadsheet.
    3. Build your KPIs.
    4. A simple dashboard to track them.
    5. Read the numbers and decide.
    6. Create a tracking routine.
5. **Between sessions.** A group to ask questions and share with the cohort.
6. **Wrap-up.** Each participant presents their own dashboard and leaves with a routine to follow on their own.
:::

[Join the waitlist](https://wa.me/5537984129390?text=Hi+Felipe+I+want+to+know+about+the+next+mentoring+cohort){.btn .btn-primary}
:::
